nodes.name: power_5v
nodes.description: TPS54331 buck converter steps VIN_MOTOR down to VCC_5V. EN pin tied to VIN for always-on operation. BOOT capacitor required between BOOT and PH. VSENSE requires resistive divider to set 5V output (passive network added in schematic phase). This module is the sole provider of VCC_5V.
Motor power to 5V Buck converter

nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO steps VCC_5V down to VCC_3V3. Input and output require bypass capacitors. This module is the sole provider of VCC_3V3 for all logic components (MCU, Drivers IO, Flash).

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: STM32F103 MCU. Core controller. BOOT0/BOOT1 configured for Flash boot (pull-down/up as per schematic). NRST requires pull-up. HSE crystal or HSI used for clock. SPI1 interface connects to Flash. Two UART channels (or GPIO bitbang) connect to TMC drivers. GPIOs drive STEP/DIR/ENN and read DIAG. VCC_3V3 powers core and IO.
ARM Cortex-M3 MCU

nodes.name: motor_driver_a
nodes.description: TMC2209 Stepper Driver Channel A. VS pins connect to VIN_MOTOR (global rail). VCC_IO connects to VCC_3V3. UART address configured via MS1/MS2 or UART command to ensure unique bus address. VREF pin requires analog voltage for current scaling (external DAC or pot). STEP/DIR/ENN controlled by MCU. DIAG output signals faults. MOTOR_OUT drives stepper coil A. SPREAD/STDBY configured for operation mode.
Stepper motor driver (channel A)
